Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b76dd9302af7803aac62243ae94d53067fc819b4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2021 10:34:34 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] um: make PCI emulation driver init/exit static

The functions aren't used elsewhere, so they can be static.

Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: 68f5d3f3b654 ("um: add PCI over virtio emulation driver")
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>
Acked-By: Anton Ivanov <anton.ivanov@cambridgegreys.com>
Signed-off-by: Richard Weinberger <richard@nod.at>

diff --git a/arch/um/drivers/virt-pci.c b/arch/um/drivers/virt-pci.c
index 0b802834f40a..70c17de16662 100644
--- a/arch/um/drivers/virt-pci.c
+++ b/arch/um/drivers/virt-pci.c
@@ -810,7 +810,7 @@ void *pci_root_bus_fwnode(struct pci_bus *bus)
 	return um_pci_fwnode;
 }
 
-int um_pci_init(void)
+static int um_pci_init(void)
 {
 	int err, i;
 
@@ -884,7 +884,7 @@ int um_pci_init(void)
 }
 module_init(um_pci_init);
 
-void um_pci_exit(void)
+static void um_pci_exit(void)
 {
 	unregister_virtio_driver(&um_pci_virtio_driver);
 	irq_domain_remove(um_pci_msi_domain);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/um/drivers/virt-pci.c`**
   - The function `um_pci_init` has been changed from a public function (non-static) to a static function. This means it can only be called within the same file.
   - The function `um_pci_exit` has also been changed from a public function to a static function, restricting its visibility to the same file.

### Relationships
- The modifications in `virt-pci.c` are related to encapsulation. By making the `um_pci_init` and `um_pci_exit` functions static, the patch improves the code's modularity and prevents potential naming conflicts with other parts of the codebase. This change is part of a broader effort to clean up the code, as indicated by the report from the kernel test robot and the associated fix for a previous commit.
